tour.s1t: Flood help, sorted for a human
tour.s1b: Kerala flood reports pile up. Relief Desk extracts facts, ranks urgency, and suggests a team. A coordinator still approves every dispatch.
tour.s2b: Tap to send a Hindi text or a synthetic voice note. The AI turns it into a case. No real people.
tour.s3t: The case lands in the queue
tour.s3b: New cases appear here, sorted by urgency. Children, rooftops and rising water rise to the top.
tour.s4b: The AI summary, triage tier, and suggested team sit here, with a road or boat route.
tour.s5b: Watch extract, dedupe, triage and team search, then awaiting human approval. No invented scores.
tour.s6t: You approve, then ask the desk
tour.s6b: Approve sends the team. Then ask how many pending cases? The desk answers from live counts.

m.hoax_false_flag_rate_pct: Real messages marked as a hoax
m.duplicate_precision_pct: Merged reports that really were the same
m.critical_case_mean_rank: Average place of an urgent case
m.latency_p50_ms: Typical time to read one message
m.latency_p95_ms: Slow time to read one message

mean.hoax_catch_rate_pct: Share of planted hoax messages we flagged. Higher is better.
mean.hoax_false_flag_rate_pct: Share of ordinary messages we wrongly called a hoax. Lower is better.
mean.false_merge_rate_pct: Share of different incidents we treated as one. Lower is better.
mean.duplicate_precision_pct: When we merge, how often it really was the same incident.
mean.duplicate_f1_pct: Balance of finding repeats without merging different incidents.
mean.duplicate_recall_pct: Share of true repeats we actually merged.
mean.people_count_exact_pct: How often the people count matches the label exactly.
mean.people_count_pm1_pct: How often the people count is exact or off by one.
mean.vulnerable_flag_macro_f1_pct: How well we notice a child, an older person, or someone sick.
mean.critical_case_top5_share_pct: Of the first five cases, how many need help now. Compared with first-come-first-served.
mean.critical_case_top10_share_pct: Of the first ten cases, how many need help now. Compared with first-come-first-served.
mean.critical_case_mean_rank: Lower means urgent cases sit nearer the top than first-come-first-served.
mean.duplicate_vs_update_3way_accuracy_pct: Telling a new incident, a repeat, and an update apart.
mean.type_accuracy_pct: How often we name the right kind of help. This is still short of the 90% target.
mean.place_ward_accuracy_pct: How often we name the right panchayat.
mean.latency_p50_ms: Half of messages are read at least this fast. Milliseconds.
mean.latency_p95_ms: Almost all messages are read by this time. Milliseconds.
mean.cost_per_1000_msgs_usd: What the reading step would cost for a thousand messages.
